package embedded
import("errors";"os";"testing")
func TestPriorRecordReader(t *testing.T){
 dir:=os.Getenv("LJ_FIXTURE_OLD_READER")
 control,e:=OpenRecords(dir,"plain","owner");if e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)};control.Close()
 h,e:=OpenRecords(dir,"sealed","owner");if h!=nil||!errors.Is(e,ErrRecordConflict){t.Fatalf("previous reader accepted or mistook sealed journal: %v",e)}
}
